test_case.test_name: Coherent Link Features: NVLink and C2C - SCC Lockable Creg Error — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Validate the platform-defined SCC Lockable Creg Error on the intended NVLink or C2C coherent path, including exact detection, containment, coherent-traffic impact and recovery, once NVIDIA defines the missing mechanism.
required_package: Authoritative expansion and architecture definition of SCC Lockable Creg Error
Pinned NVIDIA coherent-link RAS tool/spec/version/checksum and supported chip/firmware/driver/OS
Exact NVLink or C2C chip/block/register/bit/link/peer target and access ownership
Stimulus command plus severity, latch/clear, containment and expected raw status/counter/log signature
Coherent traffic, memory-ordering/data-integrity, peer/link availability and timing acceptance
Independent OOB/console/fabric recovery, abort limits and complete register/tool restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not inject. Future method must define SCC and Creg, map the register/block to chip, peer and coherent link, baseline register/counter/link/coherency state, apply one vendor-approved synthetic error or lock violation, correlate raw target-specific status and persistent RAS evidence, then prove coherent traffic, memory consistency, peers and link health recover.
